subtitle: Platform accounts and their connection status. Credentials are managed exclusively as server-side environment variables and are never stored in the frontend. Access tokens are encrypted before being stored in the database once connected.
disconnectConfirm: Really disconnect this account? You'll need to reconnect it via "Connect" afterwards.
needsCredentialsNote: Still missing: set {idVar} and {secretVar} in Render.
errorNotConfigured: {platform}: app credentials are missing. Get an API key under "Integrations" and set it in Render.
errorEncryptionMissing: TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY is not set on the server — required to securely store access tokens before an account can be connected.
errorInvalidState: Connection failed (invalid security code). Please try again.
errorExchangeFailed: Connection failed. Check the credentials and try again.
encryptionKeyMissingNotice: Note: TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY is not set yet — accounts can only be connected once this environment variable is set in Render.

composio.title: Connect an account via Composio
composio.subtitle: Alternative to the direct connection: you sign in at the platform, Composio holds the access, SECRET 58 only links the account to your workspace. Currently connect and read-only access test only – nothing is published this way.
composio.serverNotSetUp: Not set up yet: the operator has not enabled Composio on the server. Connecting is possible afterwards.
composio.connectedBanner: {platform} connected via Composio. Run the read test now.
composio.notSetUpHint: Composio is not set up on the server for this platform.
composio.renewConfirm: Sign in again? The current connection stays until the new sign-in is complete.
composio.disconnectConfirm: Really disconnect {platform}? The connection is also deleted at Composio.
composio.testOk: Read access works ({account}). This is not a publishing test.
composio.genericError: That did not work. Please try again.
composio.compareNative: Direct connection (above): sign-in directly with YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn; the publishing path is prepared there and only used after your approval.
composio.compareComposio: Composio (here): sign-in via Composio for Instagram, Facebook Page, LinkedIn and YouTube; currently read-only access test.
composio.compareReadNotPublish: A successful read test only proves access – not that publishing works.

errors.invalid_state: The response did not match your sign-in (security code). Please connect again.
errors.expired: The sign-in took too long. Please connect again.
errors.mismatch: The returned account does not belong to this workspace and was not linked.
errors.not_active: The platform did not confirm access or it was declined.
errors.composio_error: Composio was unreachable or reported an error. Please try again later.
